body:
Live validation on PR #159 exposed a fail-closed single-actor lockout after the ruleset hardening:

- exact reviewed head: 91080852320997f19ff268b65b85fb7f0d0ef5bc
- protected CI run 33283046799: test, lint, chart, integration, supply-chain all successful
- PR is MERGEABLE but BLOCKED with no reviews
- Rickebo is currently the sole organization owner, sole effective deployment-controller collaborator, sole CODEOWNER, PR author, and last pusher
- GitHub does not permit self-approval, so required code-owner plus last-push approval cannot be satisfied
- the @Agent/GitHub App connector is not attached in the current conversation

Do not weaken the ruleset or use the broadly scoped organization automation key as a workaround. The safe recovery is a trusted non-human PR-author path (narrow GitHub App installation/token) so the platform administrator can provide the required CODEOWNER/last-push approval, or a second independently trusted platform code owner.
